newsitem.title: USA: Auto sales in U.S. off 10.1 pct July 1-10 -- CNW.
newsitem.headline: Auto sales in U.S. off 10.1 pct July 1-10 -- CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the United States fell 10.1 percent in the first 10 days of July compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic autos slumped 11.6 percent, and U.S. sales of imports rose 0.6 percent.
Specifically, domestic car sales fell 12.9 percent, to 138,981 from 159,526, CNW said. Domestic truck sales fell 10.3 percent, to 135,684 from 151,238, it said.
Import car sales advanced 2.5 percent to 36,004, but import truck sales fell 7.6 percent to 7,776, the report said.
Year-to-date, vehicle sales in the United States reached 8,069,742, off 3.0 percent from the same period of 1996, according to CNW.
